title: The Tiny Animal That Survived Outer Space
description:
Tardigrades, also called water bears or moss piglets, are microscopic eight-legged animals that can survive extreme conditions. In 2007 the FOTON-M3 mission carried 30 dried-out tardigrades and 30 eggs into orbit and exposed them to space for 10 days. Vacuum alone did not harm them; vacuum plus the Sun's ultraviolet light killed many, but some revived when they were rehydrated. In their dried 'tun' state they can wait for years without food or water.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Tardigrade'.
